findings.claim: ANA sources separate Tambo 1318, Moquegua-Ilo 1317, Locumba 1316, Sama 13158, Caplina 13156 and Uchusuma 0148; the Caplina-Locumba management label must not be treated as one basin.
findings.reason_withheld: Exact official polygons have not yet been frozen and topologically checked in this package.

findings.claim: Official Moquegua-Ilo material supports distinct internal units/courses including Ilo, Osmore, Tumilaca, Torata, Huaracane, Guaneros and Pacocha.
findings.reason_withheld: No exact feature snapshot or local ravine containment has been frozen yet.

findings.claim: COEN-INDECI directly names Quebrada Chacane in a 2024-02-21 huaico in Torata.
findings.reason_withheld: Torata district attribution does not by itself prove exact containment in UH 131728 or define the channel/outlet.

findings.claim: Quebrada Zaparo has named geologic/event evidence, while the 2026 Costanera Sur Ilo and Costanera Norte Pacocha reports describe unnamed local ravines/corridors and must not be auto-attributed to Zaparo.
findings.reason_withheld: Exact child geometries and receiver topology remain unresolved.

findings.claim: IGP names Quebrada Colacaya activation in Ilabaya/Locumba context, whereas 2015/2019 Mirave evidence is territorial and cannot be assigned to Colacaya without direct evidence.
findings.reason_withheld: Mirave local ravine geometry is not identified by the cited reports.

findings.claim: COEN-INDECI reports huaico impacts in the Quebrada de los Burros corridor in 2021 and 2026, but the territorial label Sama cannot by itself establish membership in official Cuenca Sama 13158.
findings.reason_withheld: Exact channel geometry and parent containment must be frozen independently.

findings.claim: The 2019 Pachía huaico report does not name a local ravine; INGEMMET identifies Quebrada Ataspaca as debris-flow hazard/deposit context, so the event must not be assigned to Ataspaca.
findings.reason_withheld: Event-to-child attribution and exact local geometry are unresolved.

findings.claim: COEN-INDECI directly names Quebrada Volcanmayo in a 2026 Ubinas huaico, while the 2026 Omate event is unnamed; neither should be assigned to Tambo or Moquegua-Ilo without spatial adjudication.
MINAM Geoservidor exposes an ANA-derived polygon feature layer with hydrographic-unit code, hierarchy and geometry fields suitable for exact-code freezing.
findings.reason_withheld: Exact-code GeoJSON features, geometry hashes and topology QA have not yet been captured in this package.

provenance.hash_semantics: Per-source capture_sha256 in the config hashes the canonical evidence record (source_id|url|retrieved_at|bounded_claims). It is not a hash of original remote bytes.

next_safe_actions: Freeze exact-code MINAM/ANA-derived hydrographic polygons for Moquegua-Ilo, Tambo, Locumba, Sama, Caplina and related subunits; preserve source attributes and SHA-256.
Check containment/topology before binding Chacane, Zaparo, Colacaya, Quebrada de los Burros, Ataspaca or Volcanmayo to a parent hydrographic unit.
Search official channel/faja/geologic layers for reproducible local ravine geometry and outlet/confluence evidence.
Keep unnamed Ilo, Pacocha, Mirave, Pachía and Omate events as territorial evidence until exact local hydrologic identity is resolved.
Do not alter map_layers.json until reproducible geometry files pass scientific QA.
